name: Becoming a Leader — Identity Under Threat at Lumière Diagnostics
description: A four-round, advanced leadership-identity simulation set inside Lumière Diagnostics SAS, a Paris-based medical-diagnostics company (EUR 310M revenue, 17% EBITDA, 1,150 staff). Three weeks ago Dr. Camille Roche was promoted from the R&D bench to Director of the new 240-person Solutions division, skipping two management layers. Presenting the 2026 roadmap to the executive committee, she is interrupted by the CEO: 'This reads like an R&D wish-list, not a business plan. I expected a leader, not a scientist with slides.' Within 48 hours two of six team leads request transfers (destabilising ~50 of 240 staff), a pulse survey puts team confidence at 38% against a company norm of 71%, and the committee demands a revised, credible roadmap in 10 working days — with three further bench-to-leadership promotions on hold pending the outcome. Playing Roche's inner circle, you (1) separate the task problem (an R&D-heavy roadmap) from the identity problem (a provisional leader unsure she belongs) and choose a first response — defend, deflect, withdraw, or own; (2) design a holding environment by investing scarce trust and time in one or two of four developmental relationships — Trusted Peer, Former Manager / Sponsor, Direct Report, Executive Coach — neither leaning on everyone nor going it alone; (3) take a stance on the authentic–authoritative spectrum and script the conversation with the two departing leads, avoiding both the armour of false certainty and the collapse of unanchored doubt; and (4) articulate a leadership purpose that is specific, honest and sustainable enough to survive the next setback, reframe the roadmap, and pitch a 90-day confidence-recovery plan to the CEO. Grounded in Petriglieri's work on identity work, provisional selves and holding environments, the math rewards reading the right problem, selective developmental relationships and a held authentic stance — and punishes the five classic errors: fixing the slides not the self, armouring up, over-disclosing, diffuse leaning, and a slogan purpose. Final KPIs track Team Confidence (toward the 71% norm), Identity Integration, Credibility and Sustainability.

Round-by-Round Record

Leadership Identity Trajectory

text.en: Diagnose a public setback during a role transition as a threat to a still-forming leadership identity rather than a task failure, and respond to the problem actually in play
text.es: Diagnosticar un revés público durante una transición de rol como una amenaza a una identidad de liderazgo aún en formación y no como un fallo en la tarea, y responder al problema que realmente está en juego

text.en: Design a selective support structure by deliberately choosing one or two developmental relationships rather than leaning on everyone or on no one
text.es: Diseñar una red de apoyo selectiva eligiendo deliberadamente una o dos relaciones de desarrollo en lugar de apoyarse en todos o en nadie

text.en: Calibrate self-disclosure between performed certainty and unanchored doubt, and communicate a stance that holds authenticity and authority together
text.es: Calibrar la autorrevelación entre la seguridad impostada y la duda sin anclaje, y comunicar una postura que mantenga juntas la autenticidad y la autoridad

text.en: Articulate a leadership purpose specific and durable enough to guide behaviour under a future setback rather than merely describe an aspiration
text.es: Formular un propósito de liderazgo lo bastante concreto y duradero para guiar la conducta ante un futuro revés y no solo describir una aspiración

text.en: Apply the habit of separating identity threats from task failures to one's own leadership transitions
text.es: Aplicar a las propias transiciones de liderazgo el hábito de separar las amenazas a la identidad de los fallos en la tarea

name.en: Fixing the slides, not the self
name.es: Arreglar las diapositivas, no el yo

lure.en: Reading the interruption as a roadmap-quality problem is the least uncomfortable diagnosis, and the one a technical expert is best equipped to fix
lure.es: Leer la interrupción como un problema de calidad de la hoja de ruta es el diagnóstico menos incómodo, y el que una experta técnica mejor sabe resolver

consequence.en: A rebuilt roadmap alone does not move the 38% pulse survey: identity integration falls and the room's doubt, which was never about the slides, stays untouched
consequence.es: Rehacer la hoja de ruta no mueve por sí solo la encuesta de pulso del 38%: la integración de identidad cae y la duda de la sala, que nunca fue por las diapositivas, sigue intacta

source.ref: TN §13 'Fixing the slides, not the self (Round 1)'; §7 Q1 suggested analysis; TN-Exhibit 1

name.en: Leaning only on the former manager
name.es: Apoyarse solo en el antiguo jefe

lure.en: The sponsor is the most powerful person available and the one whose backing lends most credibility with the committee
lure.es: El patrocinador es la persona más poderosa disponible y aquella cuyo respaldo da más credibilidad ante el comité

consequence.en: Credibility rises at once, but leaning on the sponsor alone clings to the old expert identity: identity integration and sustainability pay for it
consequence.es: La credibilidad sube enseguida, pero apoyarse solo en el patrocinador es aferrarse a la antigua identidad de experta: lo pagan la integración de identidad y la sostenibilidad

source.ref: TN §7 Q2 suggested analysis; §11 takeaway 3; TN-Exhibit 2 'Sponsor chosen alone'

name.es: Ponerse la armadura ante la sala

lure.en: Projecting total certainty feels like protecting team morale: the room needs confidence right now
lure.es: Proyectar una seguridad total parece proteger la moral del equipo: la sala necesita confianza ahora mismo

consequence.en: The two leads sat in the committee meeting and hear a confidence they know is manufactured: confidence and credibility fall, and a second lead leaves
consequence.es: Los dos jefes estuvieron en la reunión del comité y oyen una seguridad que saben fabricada: caen la confianza y la credibilidad, y se marcha un segundo jefe

source.ref: TN §13 'Armouring up (Round 3)'; §7 Q3 likely positions; §5.5; TN-Exhibit 3

lure.en: Admitting everything feels like honesty that builds trust, usually chosen to overcorrect against false certainty
lure.es: Admitirlo todo parece una honestidad que genera confianza, y suele elegirse para corregir en exceso la falsa seguridad

consequence.en: A room told everything inherits the leader's anxiety: team confidence drops as admission shades from candour into doubt about her competence
consequence.es: Una sala a la que se le cuenta todo hereda la ansiedad de la líder: la confianza del equipo cae cuando la admisión pasa de la franqueza a la duda sobre su competencia

name.en: A well-phrased slogan for a purpose
name.es: Un eslogan bien redactado como propósito

lure.en: An inspiring, innovative-leader statement sounds like what a CEO wants to hear in a three-minute meeting
lure.es: Una declaración de líder inspiradora e innovadora suena a lo que un CEO quiere oír en una reunión de tres minutos

consequence.en: The purpose tells her nothing to do at the next interruption: sustainability falls and the top grade is out of reach
consequence.es: El propósito no le dice qué hacer ante la próxima interrupción: la sostenibilidad cae y la máxima calificación queda fuera de alcance

source.ref: TN §7 Q4 likely positions; §13 'Treating specific purpose as merely detailed'; §11 takeaway 5; TN-Exhibit 4
